title: Modern 4602D personnel attend Ramsay lecture
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Modern 4602D personnel attend Ramsay lecture, about unspecified at Denver, Colorado, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher of an alleged UFO crash in New Mexico, says people from today's version of the 4602D, an Air Force intelligence unit tied to investigating UFO reports, came to one of his lectures. He says this happened in Denver, Colorado. If true, it would suggest the military still quietly follows UFO research.
